title: Core DSPy Primitives
summary: This module defines the fundamental building blocks and data structures for constructing DSPy programs, managing language model interactions, and supporting REPL environments. It provides the core abstractions for modules, types, and serialization.

nodes.label: BaseModule
nodes.title: Base DSPy Module
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionalities like parameter management, sub-module discovery, and state serialization/deserialization.

nodes.label: Module
nodes.title: DSPy Program Base Class
nodes.description: The primary class for defining DSPy programs, extending BaseModule with program logic, callback handling, and management of prediction components.

nodes.label: SandboxSerializable
nodes.title: RLM Sandbox Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for types that can be serialized and injected into an RLM (Reinforcement Learning Module) sandbox for dynamic execution.

nodes.label: LM Request Object
nodes.title: Language Model Request
nodes.description: A standardized object encapsulating all parameters for a Language Model call, including messages, tools, and configuration settings.

nodes.label: LM Message
nodes.title: Language Model Message
nodes.description: A fundamental data structure representing a single message in an LM conversation, with a role (e.g., system, user, assistant) and content parts.

nodes.label: LM Stream Handler
nodes.title: Language Model Stream
nodes.description: Manages the synchronous or asynchronous streaming of Language Model responses, processing events and building the final LMResponse object.

nodes.label: LM Response Object
nodes.title: Language Model Response
nodes.description: Represents the complete output from a Language Model, including generated text, tool calls, usage statistics, and other metadata.

nodes.label: LM History Entry
nodes.title: LM Call History Record
nodes.description: A typed record of an LM call, storing the request, response, and derived convenience fields for historical analysis and debugging.

nodes.label: REPLVariable
nodes.title: REPL Sandbox Variable
nodes.description: A Pydantic model that stores and formats metadata for a variable within a REPL session, including its name, type, description, and a preview of its value.

nodes.label: LM Client
nodes.title: Language Model Integration
nodes.description: An external service or client responsible for interacting with various Language Models to perform text generation or other LM tasks.

nodes.label: Serialization Storage
nodes.title: Persistent Storage
nodes.description: File system or database used for persisting the state or entire program architecture of DSPy modules (e.g., JSON, PKL files).

nodes.label: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.title: Pydantic Data Model
nodes.description: An external library's base class for creating data models with type hints and validation, used by DSPy for structured data definitions.

groups.label: Program Building Blocks
groups.title: Core Program Building Blocks
groups.description: Foundational classes for defining DSPy modules, managing their lifecycle, and enabling serialization for advanced features like sandboxing.

groups.label: LM Interaction Data Flow
groups.title: Language Model Interaction Data
groups.description: Standardized data structures and processes for constructing LM requests, handling messages, streaming responses, and maintaining a history of LM calls.

groups.label: Serialization & REPL Utilities
groups.title: Serialization & REPL Utilities
groups.description: Components facilitating the persistence of module states, representing variables in REPL environments, and leveraging Pydantic for structured data.

groups.label: External LM Interface
groups.title: External LM Interface
groups.description: Represents the external Language Model services that DSPy's core primitives interact with to perform generative tasks.
